verdict.rationale: Box's first-party docs describe registrable webhooks that send notifications to a URL of your choice when content events occur, including V2 webhooks (e.g., on file download) and a V1 vs V2 comparison. An enterprise/user event stream is also documented for real-time or historical change monitoring. missing for 10: documented webhook signature verification, documented delivery retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
